name: analysis-kit
description: Session analysis toolkit for Claude Code: component retrospectives, tool/framework auditing, actor behavior analysis, governance and conflict detection, session/specification comparison, recurring-pattern mining, cross-report findings review, classified improvement recommendations, and third-party review-learnings mining/management — grounded in a session, date range, or a set of merged PRs, with reports persisted for later reference, a guided front door to pick the right analysis type without needing to already know the other skills' names, and a multi-run orchestrator that consolidates several analyses into one prioritized action list and hands off to a guided fix pass.
